prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Meal Planning Web App (Chat GPT & Stripe)
Looking to design a web app that can help plan meals for families including recipe development via ChatGPT and generating grocery shopping lists based on the ingredients in the recipe. Basically, people create an account, verify email and then purchase a meal plan and then are asked to submit answers to a multi-step form (I will provide the questions), and get access to a customer portal which will show their order. The web app should be able to give the full recipe, cooking instructions, and shopping list which chat GPT can produce.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Contract clause search assistant
client: confidential
client_industry: legal

end: 2023-06
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Python
- LangChain

  the clause and page it used.

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Contract clause search assistant (p05).

text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience building practical AI and machine learning solutions. I’d be excited to help you create a meal planning web app that combines ChatGPT-driven recipe generation, grocery list creation, account access, and a smooth customer portal experience for your users.

Your project is a strong fit for my background in Python, NLP, LangChain, OpenAI API, and web-backed AI workflows. I understand the core flow you want: users create an account, verify their email, purchase a meal plan through Stripe, complete a multi-step intake form, and then receive a portal where their order and generated meal plan can be accessed. I can help design the logic behind the experience so the app feels organized, reliable, and easy to use from sign-up through final delivery.

I’ve built an assistant that answers questions over 9,000 contracts and always quotes the clause and page it used. In that project, I used Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, pgvector, PostgreSQL, and FastAPI. One result was improving clause lookup from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. That experience gave me extensive practice designing AI-powered systems that need to be accurate, structured, and user-friendly.

For your app, I would focus on:
- clear user onboarding and account flow
- Stripe-based purchase handling
- multi-step form processing
- recipe generation with ChatGPT
- shopping list generation from recipe ingredients
- a customer portal that shows order status and plan details

I’m comfortable working with structured data, API integrations, and machine learning workflows, and I’d approach this as a system that needs both thoughtful UX and dependable backend logic. I also understand the importance of making AI outputs usable, so the recipe, instructions, and grocery list should be presented in a clean and practical format for families.

One question I have: should the meal plan output be generated immediately after checkout, or only after the user completes the full multi-step form?
